stories.title: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
stories.take: A new alignment idea: design the incentives so AI agents police themselves — mechanism design as a leash, not just guardrails.

stories.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
stories.take: Schools can turn off Google's AI, but the price is losing Search too — a bundle that makes opting out hard to actually choose.

stories.title: UEFI bootkit infected fully patched Windows machines. Is Microsoft to blame?
stories.take: A bootkit beat fully patched Windows by exploiting fuzzy Secure Boot rules — the flaw is below the OS, so patching alone won't fix it.

stories.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
stories.take: Apple is putting dating apps and AI companions behind an 18+ gate — age assurance is becoming platform policy, not just app policy.

stories.title: The agentic web is here
stories.take: MIT Tech Review says the web is being rebuilt for agents, not browsers — sites that agents can't use will lose traffic first, relevance second.

stories.title: Shopify Stores Face Suspected AI-Driven Attacks
stories.take: Shopify storefronts are facing suspected AI-driven attacks found by a shopper buying a keyboard — commerce security is now an AI problem.

stories.title: As Publicis closes LiveRamp deal, some brands say they’re jumping ship
stories.take: Publicis closed LiveRamp, and some brands say they're jumping ship — consolidation in data is creating churn, not just scale.

stories.title: People Inc. is building custom APIs to make its journalism easier for AI agents to use
stories.take: People Inc. is building APIs so AI agents can use its journalism cleanly — publishers are starting to sell access to machines, not just readers.

stories.title: Is this the most controversial font since Comic Sans?
stories.take: Creative Bloq flags AI's favorite typeface as the new Comic Sans fight — loud, everywhere, and already a shorthand for generic AI design.

stories.title: After AI backlash, Svedka challenges consumers to create Super Bowl ad
stories.take: After an AI backlash, Svedka is challenging consumers to create its Super Bowl ad — crowdsourcing as both apology and campaign.

stories.title: Luka stays hot with 42, earns high praise from Giannis that 'some people are scared to say'
stories.take: Luka Dončić dropped 42 in a Lakers win over Miami and drew praise from Giannis — the hot streak is now the league's early-season story.

stories.title: SGA, with 'look in his eye,' nets 43 as Thunder hand Cavaliers first home loss
stories.take: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 43 as Oklahoma City handed Cleveland its first home loss — a statement win from the defending champs' core.

stories.title: Draymond ejected after scuffle with Brooks, Suns; Curry says it 'lit a fire' in Warriors
stories.take: Draymond Green picked up his first ejection of the season in a Warriors-Suns scuffle — Curry said it lit a fire, which is the familiar trade-off.

stories.title: Three notable decisions from NBA's rookie-scale extension deadline: Thunder seemingly give up on lottery pick
stories.take: At the rookie-extension deadline, Oklahoma City appears ready to move on from a lottery pick — even contenders are cutting sunk costs early.

stories.title: Why MLB could see an early free agency frenzy before the potential Dec. 1 lockout
stories.take: Free agency could sprint before a possible Dec. 1 lockout — last time, teams spent $1.7B in the month before the deadline.

stories.title: Tarik Skubal contract predictions: Ace's new deal could break multiple MLB records for a pitcher
stories.take: Tarik Skubal's next deal could break pitcher records held by Yamamoto's $325M — he's the offseason's clear No. 1 prize.

stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong, Jacob Misiorowski, more named finalists for MVP, Cy Young and Rookie of the Year awards
stories.take: Award finalists are out, with Pete Crow-Armstrong and Jacob Misiorowski headlining — playoff results don't count, regular season does.

stories.title: Eight MLB players tagged with $23.15M qualifying offer: Randy Arozarena, Seiya Suzuki, Jake Bauers, more
stories.take: Eight players got the $23.15M qualifying offer, including Arozarena and Suzuki — they have until Nov. 17 to accept or test the market.

stories.title: It's Election Day. Control of Congress is on the line, and what else you need to know
stories.take: Election Day is here with control of Congress at stake — treat tonight as a referendum on Trump's agenda, with results that may not land tonight.

stories.title: Why it could take a while to know who will control Congress
stories.take: Don't expect a clean call early: close House races, late counts and ranked-choice in Maine and Alaska could stretch the control question for days.

stories.title: Trump faces prospect of impeachment if Democrats gain control
stories.take: If Democrats take control, Trump faces a real impeachment prospect — that's the subtext driving turnout on both sides today.

stories.title: US midterm elections 2026 live: Americans go to the polls in referendum on Trump’s agenda
stories.take: The Guardian's live results cover Senate, House and governors in all 50 states — the rolling page to keep open tonight.

stories.title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
stories.take: Swing voters describe the country as messy, divided and scary heading into Election Day — affordability and unease, not enthusiasm, are the mood.

stories.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian aid site kill at least 31 people, with dozens still missing
stories.take: Russian strikes on a Ukrainian aid site killed at least 31, with dozens missing — the war's humanitarian toll escalated on U.S. Election Day.

stories.title: Live Election Day updates: Newsom sends lawyers to monitor polls
stories.take: Newsom sent lawyers to monitor California polls as voters pick a governor and decide 14 propositions — the state is bracing for disputes.

stories.title: ¿Controlarán los demócratas el Congreso? Su camino pasa por California. No te pierdas estas contiendas
stories.take: California's House races could decide control of Congress — CalMatters maps the contests that also shape the Democrats' future direction.

stories.title: Majority of California voters fear federal government may try to stop vote count, poll finds
stories.take: A majority of California voters fear the federal government may try to stop the vote count, per a new poll — trust in the count itself is on the ballot.

stories.title: Billions on the line for schools as voters decide Prop. 3 high-income tax
stories.take: Prop. 3 would make the high-income tax for schools permanent, with billions on the line for K-12 — one of today's most consequential California votes.

stories.title: California chooses next insurance commissioner: Jane Kim or Ben Allen
stories.take: Voters pick the next insurance commissioner after a decade of wildfires broke the property market — Jane Kim vs. Ben Allen, both Democrats.

stories.title: Ukraine accuses Russia of hitting school used as aid centre
stories.take: Ukraine says Russia hit a school used as an aid centre near Zaporizhzhia with at least nine 3,000-kg glide bombs, killing at least 26 including rescuers • Midterms framed as a referendum on Trump: affordability and ICE backlash dominate, Republicans expect House losses and would count holding the Senate as a good night • Snap settled an addiction-design lawsuit from two teens; Meta, YouTube and TikTok had already settled

stories.title: Americans vote in pivotal midterm elections
stories.take: Midterms will shape Trump's final two years: Republicans hold both chambers, Trump approval nears its low, and affordability is voters' top concern • Key races: Michigan's El-Sayed vs. Rogers, Georgia's Ossoff vs. Collins over Obamacare costs up 26%, Texas and a spoiler-name fight in Alaska • Binance hit by a record $6.3B hack — North Korea denies the FBI's accusation, and $3B was withdrawn after trading resumed

stories.title: Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Hype INTENSIFIES - Kinda Funny Games Daily 11.02.26
stories.take: Ocarina of Time remake is confirmed as Nintendo's core Zelda team (EPD Group No. 3, Aonuma and Fujibayashi), positioned as the definitive version for Zelda's 40th anniversary • Preview is IGN's No. 2 of the year behind GTA 6, with 1.8M+ YouTube views • Phantom Blade Zero sold 4M copies in 72 hours; Nagoshi Studio has shut down in NetEase's pullback

stories.title: An Election Day Special With Nate Silver
stories.take: Nate Silver's call: House is close to a lock for Democrats (~5% chance Republicans hold it), Democrats lead the generic ballot by ~9 points, and his model puts Senate odds in the high 70s for Democrats vs. ~68% on prediction markets • Trump approval ~37% — worst at a midterm since Truman in 1946 — driven by gas prices and the Iran war • Gerrymanders may backfire as a 'dummymander' in Florida and Texas in a D+9 climate

stories.title: The Sporting Class: Baseball's Salary Cap, Universal Playoff Expansion... and Elon Musk, Owner?
stories.take: Elon Musk, owner? No — Samson says Musk wouldn't buy one team, he'd try to buy the whole league, and he wouldn't get the 23 owner votes for a single club anyway • A Dec. 1 lockout is treated as certain, with owners pushing a salary cap that 54–58% of fans favor in polling • Likely trade if a deal comes: cap and floor for more money to younger players, earlier free agency and a higher minimum

stories.title: Anthropic's Q3 Results Are In — The Costs Are Exploding
stories.take: Anthropic Q3: $17B revenue, up ~12x year over year, but growth slowed to 47% quarter over quarter from 144% • Costs are exploding: $895B in compute commitments, ~$70B due in the next 12 months, and quarterly compute costs jumped $3.4B → $5.6B → $9.9B • Nasdaq 100 is in correction, AI names have lost ~$5T in a month, and Zandi describes a split economy — A++ for stock owners, D for the rest

stories.title: A Guide to Election Night 2026
stories.take: What to watch, in order: 6 p.m. ET Kentucky/Indiana, then 7 p.m. Southeast — early tells are Kentucky's 6th, redrawn Trump+10 districts in NC/FL, and SC/FL Senate races; beware a blue mirage in the first 45 minutes • Democrats are heavy favorites for the House; Senate control likely won't be clear until ~midnight, and Maine/Alaska could take days • Final Times polls put Democrats ahead in all seven decisive Senate states, with Nate Cohn calling the likeliest outcome 'maybe scenario 3.7' of a blue wave

stories.title: Is it time to reconsider the adjustable rate mortgage?
stories.take: Yes — for some borrowers, not most: since 1971 ARMs worked out ~70% of the time, with a typical ~50bp saving (6.5% vs. 7% fixed at 7.2%) and a shot to refinance lower • An ARM fits younger, higher-income borrowers with a cushion for a higher reset; it's a poor fit for fixed-income buyers who need certainty • ARMs are back to ~11% of new applications, the highest in over a year

stories.title: Election Day final stretch, Early turnout beating expectations, UCLA women begin title defense— Morning Edition
stories.take: Supreme Court rejected Trump's bid to set aside ~20,000 California ballots, with no public dissent • Early turnout beats expectations: 1.4M ballots in LA County (~24%) and 600k in Orange County (~33%), results after polls close at 8 p.m. • Lakers beat Miami 138-117 behind Luka's 42 — his fourth 40-point game in five — and JuJu Watkins scored 21 in her return for USC

stories.title: Election Day, Trump's Closing Message, Iran War And The Midterms
stories.take: Election Day: Democrats favored for the House, Trump's popularity near historic lows, and red states like Iowa, Kansas and Mississippi unexpectedly competitive • Trump's closing speech focused on the reflecting pool for 20 minutes before elections, prompting GOP concern he gave candidates no pocketbook cover • U.S. reported defensive strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz; Iran offered to reopen the Strait in two days if talks resume

stories.title: Did Trump Do Enough to Help Republicans?
stories.take: No clear yes: Trump made the election about himself — 'pretend I'm on the ballot' — and spent ~30 minutes of his final speech on the reflecting pool, not affordability or Iran, and his heart 'wasn't in it' late, per the Journal's Paletta • It may not matter: millions voted early, including 7.5M in Texas alone, above recent midterm rates • Also: LNG output set for a record 3% drop as the Hormuz closure bites, and Palantir's U.S. government business nearly doubled
